articles.title: NEET paper leak: Delhi court extends judicial custody of 5 accused till June 15
articles.summary: A Delhi court extended the judicial custody of five accused in the NEET paper leak case until June 15. Special Judge Ajay Gupta granted the CBI's request for the extension, indicating continued legal action. This development underscores the ongoing efforts by authorities to investigate and prosecute those involved in compromising the integrity of crucial national entrance examinations, ensuring accountability in such high-stakes cases.

articles.title: India, Germany explore cooperation in quantum communication, space and deep-tech innovation
articles.summary: India and Germany are exploring expanded cooperation in crucial deep-tech domains. Discussions encompassed quantum communication, photonics, quantum satellite communication, and various space technologies. This collaboration aims to bolster scientific capabilities and foster strategic partnerships in frontier areas. Such initiatives are vital for advancing India's technological prowess and global position in emerging fields.

articles.title: Patrik Laine sparks controversy following revealing healthy status during Montreal Canadiens NHL season absence comments
articles.summary: NHL player Patrik Laine has sparked controversy by revealing he was healthy during his absence from the Montreal Canadiens' NHL season. This statement contradicts previous understanding, raising questions about his prolonged time away from the team and potential miscommunication regarding his physical status. The incident highlights player-team relations in professional sports.
